result: The compliance-aware gate now has a superseding reserved-score runtime facade. New ADMITs reconstruct reporting state through compliance replay, while score/reservation/bound-SLOT operations inject that gate into immutable historical modules. The facade also fixes persisted reservation provenance: the historical attempt module labels RESERVE events with the historical gate even when another gate is injected, so the facade re-encodes the event with the actual compliance-aware gate binding before acknowledgement without changing reservation payload/digest or attempt identity.
validated_contracts: Two-block restart with a physically favorable but reservation-noncompliant block-1 SLOT: raw block score 0, scientific compliance score 1/3, next ADMIT succeeds after compliance replay, stale block-1 launch authority is rejected, block-2 scientific score is 1/2, and two full restarts preserve exactly two scientific rows.
Historical legacy reporting replay conflicts on the intentionally changed audited block-1 row, demonstrating why it cannot remain the next-ADMIT recovery authority.

Facade syntax compiles and a dependency-injected reservation stub shows persisted gate provenance is rewritten to the compliance-aware gate while reservation_digest remains unchanged and the runtime binding names the new gate blob.
measurement_validity_rules: Recovery authority and wire-format compatibility are separate: keep historical ADMIT/SLOT encoding, but use compliance replay to reconstruct numerical reporting state after an audited CLOSE.

Per-slot launch liveness after a compliance-issued capability should validate the exact acknowledged ADMIT prefix and current raw active-ADMIT identity rather than rerun historical numerical reporting semantics.

Dependency injection is not sufficient provenance if an immutable historical module persists hard-coded module labels. A superseding facade must ensure durable receipts/events describe the module that actually authorized the action, while leaving scientific identity/digest fields unchanged.

Provenance correction here is traceability hardening, not a new acceptance predicate: current reservation compliance checks reservation identity, SLOT attempt binding and exact COMMIT-to-SLOT linkage.
Historical modules remain immutable for reproducibility; the superseding path must be explicit and blob-pinned.
scope_limitations: The two-block lifecycle and reservation-provenance test used deterministic dependency-injected interfaces; the complete exact production sibling graph was not byte-executed in one repository-local runtime.
The new gate/facade were syntax-checked locally, but no new crash-injection campaign was run across their complete durable append/fsync/readback chain in this invocation.
No conclusion extends beyond the tested durability/replay/provenance contracts.
frontier: Byte-execute reserved_score_runtime_compliance_2026-08-28.py against its exact blob-pinned production siblings in one repository-local runtime and compare every durable event/result with the dependency-injected contract results.

Crash-inject every boundary from durable compliance CLOSE through restart, next ADMIT append/fsync/readback, RESERVE acknowledgement, score, bound SLOT and COMMIT; require exact continuation or fail-closed unresolved state with no duplicate scoring.

Decide whether reservation_compliance_auditor should also verify the persisted gate/runtime provenance binding. Add that check only if it improves scientific evidence integrity without making harmless historical provenance differences invalidate otherwise exact attempt evidence.
Add cross-process writer lease/fencing before claiming simultaneous-launch safety.
exact_next_action: Run the superseding facade against exact production siblings. If repository-local byte execution is still unavailable, build a stronger injected adapter that uses the actual historical reservation event schema/frame codec and compliance audit predicates, then crash-inject the compliance-CLOSE to next-ADMIT/RESERVE transition and verify no duplicate scorer invocation, exact scientific replay, and correct new-gate provenance.
